summary.en: An editorial guide for practical, human-scale product stories.
summary.pt-BR: Um guia editorial para histórias de produto práticas e humanas.

voice.summary: Warm, specific and observant. Give useful details the space usually given to slogans.
principles: Prefer concrete verbs and details over broad claims.
Let one useful observation carry the headline.
Keep calls to action clear and unhurried.

examples.before: A revolutionary platform for modern teams.
examples.after: Keep the team's decisions where the work happens.

global: Use the page background and ink tokens as the base for both color schemes.
Pair editorial headings with a calm, readable body face.
Use rules and spacing to create rhythm before adding decoration.

classic.direction: A careful field guide with a strict column and quiet accents.
rules: Keep the headline short and left aligned.
Use one restrained accent and no motion.

refined.direction: An open editorial page with generous margins and one precise detail.
rules: Give the lead room to breathe beside the headline.
Use hairline rules instead of decorative shadows.

bold.direction: A confident product story with an oversized headline and an asymmetric split.
rules: Let the headline and the action occupy different visual weights.
Use the accent color for one memorable mark.

avant-garde.direction: A field journal cover with a headline that becomes the main graphic.
rules: Treat the headline as the main composition.
Keep every essential detail readable without motion or decoration.

invariants: Maintain at least 4.5:1 contrast for normal text.
Keep all controls reachable and usable with a keyboard.
Keep the layout readable at 360 pixels without horizontal scrolling.

title.en: Good ideas need somewhere to land.
title.pt-BR: Boas ideias precisam de onde pousar.

lead.en: A small, considered workspace for turning a team's notes into useful pages.
lead.pt-BR: Um espaço simples e cuidadoso para transformar as notas do time em páginas úteis.
